- memory_id "1000167": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000201" [decision]: Priya Raman is the primary on-call for the Atlas team as of 2025-02-12, and Tomasz is off rotation.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000145": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka is on the Cinder team.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000251": As of 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team.  (about: billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000103" [decision]: Oskar takes the first on-call shift of the year for the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000134": The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
